claims.hypothesis: The observed Class 0 radius distribution is consistent with hydrodynamic, Hall-effect and ambipolar-diffusion disk formation models
claims.experiment: Compare the 52 Class 0 dust radii (treated as gas radii) with model predictions
claims.result: Median about 40 au with a long tail to large radii; only 1 of 52 unresolved; models predict over 100 au, bimodal, or about 18-20 au with little spread
claims.finding: The distribution is in high tension with all three model classes

evidence.quote: We show that the distribution of radii in the 52 Class 0 disks in our sample is in high tension with various disk formation models, indicating that protostellar disk formation remains an unsolved question.

claims.hypothesis: Substructures are present in young Class 0/I disks at 15-18 au resolution
claims.experiment: Visual identification in the 0.1 arcsec continuum images
claims.result: 21 disks with substructures or asymmetries, 5 new, including annular substructure in two Class I and two flat sources
claims.finding: New annular substructures and asymmetries are found in embedded disks

evidence.quote: Our key findings include the detection of new annular substructures in two Class I and two flat-spectrum sources, while 21 embedded protostars exhibit distinct asymmetries or substructures in their disks.

referee_caveats_inferred: Class 0 dust radii are compared with gas-radius model predictions while the paper's own Rgas/Rmm trend rests on about 25 heterogeneous literature disks, so the model-tension claim is only as strong as that assumption
Gaussian FWHM-based radii at 0.1 arcsec resolution are biased for sources near the beam size and for non-Gaussian profiles; mixed 15 and 18 au samples and a 436 pc cloud group probe different scales
Anderson-Darling p-values of 0.23 and 0.06 for the pooled classes are weak, so the headline Class 0 to Class I shrinkage rests on per-cloud subsamples (Serpens and Aquila p = 0.03)
Tbol classes come partly from an unpublished catalog, so class assignment cannot be independently checked
Per-cloud statistics mix different distances, sensitivities and PWV conditions (Chamaeleon has fewer antennas and higher PWV)

missing_for_reproduction: Manually drawn self-cal and final clean masks, and the modified auto_selfcal code
Full tclean parameter set (cell, image size, niter, scales, nterms, threshold)
Unpublished eHOPS Tbol/class table for Chamaeleon, Ophiuchus, Ophiuchus North and Corona Australis
imfit initial conditions and the list of fit failures per weighting
Reference keys for the literature R_gas/R_mm compilation and the exact Anderson-Darling and EMG fitting settings
reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: 14 scheduling blocks of 12 m Band 6 TDM continuum (4 x 1.875 GHz SPWs, 16-48 min each); roughly 0.1-0.5 TB raw, tens of GB as calibrated measurement sets
reproducibility.score_reason: Scale 1-5. Observing setup, CASA version, weighting and radius-measurement recipe are clear and the inputs are a single project, but manual clean masks, the modified self-cal code, full tclean settings and an unpublished classification catalog are missing.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: The paper does not state that the data are public, and the manual masks, modified self-cal code and unpublished eHOPS classes prevent an exact redo, although the radii are numeric.
